I am identifying the memo metadata fields—such as tags, properties, and mentions—that are computed from content rather than set by the user.

I found that `memopayload.RePayload` uses `markdownService.ExtractAll`, called from `memo_service.go` on create and update. I am now searching for payload rebuilding and `ExtractAll` usage to identify the exact computation site, triggers, and extracted properties.

Reading memo_service.go to find UpdateMemo triggers and memopayload/runner to locate the metadata computation logic.

Checking ExtractAll in markdown.go for extracted properties. Verifying whether CreateMemoComment triggers a rebuild.

Checking the markdown file for ExtractAll.

Now examining the full extracted properties list. Will check CreateMemoComment for payload rebuild logic. Will also review user_service_stats to see how payload drives lists and previews.

Checking whether CreateMemoComment calls RebuildMemoPayload.

CreateMemoComment may use an internal creation path.

Beginning to identify where derived metadata is computed.

The computation site is `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`. It delegates to `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

Triggers are `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` when the content path is modified, and `CreateMemoComment` through indirect `CreateMemo` calls.

A batch rebuild path exists in `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce`, but it is not wired into production startup.

`RebuildMemoPayload` only writes Tags and Property to the payload. Mentions extracted by `ExtractAll` are discarded by this function and handled separately for notifications.

Tags are extracted from markdown `#tags` directives. Property fields include the title from the first H1 heading, plus flags for links, code blocks, task lists, and incomplete tasks. Mentions are extracted but discarded by `RebuildMemoPayload`.

Derived metadata includes tags and properties such as has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, and title. These are computed from memo content rather than set by the user.

Location is user-set. Snippet is generated at read time and not stored in the payload. Payload fields are recomputed during CreateMemo, UpdateMemo when content changes, and CreateMemoComment.

A batch runner at memopayload.Runner.RunOnce exists but is not wired into server startup.

memopayload.RunOnce is not wired into the production server.

RebuildMemoPayload computes derived metadata via ExtractAll. It runs during CreateMemo and UpdateMemo(content). The server/runner/memopayload/runner.go site calls internal/markdown/markdown.go ExtractAll to walk the AST. RebuildMemoPayload stores Tags and Prope in the payload. ExtractAll also finds Mentions, but those are kept in memo_mention_helpers and not persisted in the payload.

The answer should list only Tags and Prope as extracted properties, omitting Mentions.
